profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | React • .NET • AWS • Agentic AI • Generative AI | Data-Driven Development Enthusiast
profile.summary:
I’m a Lead Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience delivering scalable, enterprise-grade full-stack applications across web, cloud, and microservices ecosystems.

My core expertise lies in modern web development using Angular, React, TypeScript, and .NET Core—along with architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS. I specialize in breaking down complex monoliths into modular microservices and building production-grade SPAs and Micro Frontends (MFEs).

I’ve led Agile teams, adoption, implemented best practices, and leveraged AI tools like GitHub Copilot to speed up development while maintaining high-quality code.

 I actively leverage AI, GitHub Copilot workflows to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and enhance developer productivity. I’m passionate about spec-driven development, context engineering, AI skills and instruction design, and modern “vibe-coding” practices that blend human creativity with AI capabilities.

⸻

🔹 What I Bring
• Architected & deployed Micro Frontends and modern SPAs
• Migrated legacy systems to microservices using AWS + IaC (Terraform)
• Led Agile teams through digital transformation initiatives
• Built CI/CD pipelines and drove full DevOps lifecycle adoption
• Integrated observability tools (Grafana, CloudWatch, Splunk, InfluxDB)
• Leveraged AI-powered development tools and Agentic AI workflows to accelerate engineering delivery
• Applied spec-driven development, context-aware engineering, and reusable AI instructions and skills to improve software quality and team productivity
• Mentored engineers and cultivated high-performing, collaborative engineering teams

⸻

🛠️ Tech Stack Highlights
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, SQL
Frameworks: Angular, React, Next.js, ASP.NET MVC
Cloud: AWS (ECS, S3, Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch)
DevOps: Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, CircleCI
AI & Modern Engineering: Generative AI, Agentic AI, GitHub Copilot, Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, Spec-Driven Development, AI-Assisted Software Engineering
Observability: Grafana, Kibana, InfluxDB, Splunk
Tools: GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio, VS Code, JIRA, TFS
Databases: MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle

🎓 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
🎓 Post Graduate Program in Generative AI – Texas McCombs School of Business
🎓 Post Graduate Program in AI Agents – Texas McCombs School of Business

I’m passionate about building modern platforms, embracing AI-driven engineering, and helping organizations deliver software faster, smarter, and at scale.
